maria: Heads up — hotpatch PR #6291 (kv-cache canary regression) needs a second approval to merge before 14:00 PT cutoff. I pushed a tiny fix and a test. @alex you reviewed the first pass; can you re-approve? @katie can you be the second if CI and canary smoke look good? If we miss cutoff we'll hold for the next deploy.
release-bot: CI summary for PR #6291: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e ✅, canary-smoke ⚠️ (flaky). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6291
alex: on it, pulling down branch and running a local smoke now.
katie: I can second but need a short replicated load test to be comfortable. Jun — can you run the quick harness against the canary? :pray:
jun: starting smoke runner: `./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 6291 --subset kv_cache` — ETA ~6m
jun: smoke results: ```PASS kv_cache_regen: 120s total, 0 failures, avg latency 48ms``` logs: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/6291/smoke.log
alex: verified change locally and reviewed tests. Everything looks safe. dropping LGTM :thumbsup:
katie: saw Jun's pass and Alex's LGTM, seconding LGTM. Please have release-bot proceed with merge after final canary ack.
release-bot: Canary smoke now passing consistently (3/3 runs). Merge queued and will execute in 30s.
maria: Merged at 14:05 PT. Thanks everyone — I'll watch the dashboard for kv-cache error spikes and add a note to the release timeline. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall.
